# Traverse VPN

> Traverse VPN is a privacy-first VPN service for secure browsing, public Wi-Fi protection, IP masking, and fast VPN access across devices.

Traverse VPN helps users browse privately, protect internet traffic on public Wi-Fi, hide their IP address, and download VPN apps for major platforms.

- [Homepage](https://traversevpn.com/) - Secure VPN landing page.
- [Features](https://traversevpn.com/features) - VPN privacy, speed, security, and device features.
- [Plans](https://traversevpn.com/plans) - VPN subscription plans.
- [Downloads](https://traversevpn.com/downloads) - Download Traverse VPN apps.
- [Android VPN](https://traversevpn.com/vpn-for-android) - VPN app for Android devices.
- [iPhone VPN](https://traversevpn.com/vpn-for-iphone) - VPN app for iPhone and iOS devices.
- [Windows VPN](https://traversevpn.com/vpn-for-windows) - VPN app for Windows.
- [Mac VPN](https://traversevpn.com/vpn-for-mac) - VPN app for macOS.
- [Linux VPN](https://traversevpn.com/vpn-for-linux) - VPN app for Linux.
- [Enterprise VPN](https://traversevpn.com/enterprise) - VPN solutions for teams and businesses.
- [Blog](https://traversevpn.com/blogs) - VPN guides, privacy tips, and security articles.
- [FAQs](https://traversevpn.com/faqs) - Frequently asked questions.
